network.layout: Up to 160 nodes: deterministic spiral seed, stronger D3 relationship links and weak centering, settled for 350 ticks, then rectangular label separation. Larger views: linear-time breadth-first relationship-ordered grid. List skips physics. Dynamic plane bounds retain an 800px by 500px minimum.
network.interaction: Node pointer capture excludes canvas pan; drag uses pointer-down scale. Pointer focus does not recenter; moved drags suppress inspection. Keyboard reveal only handles offscreen nodes and preserves zoom. Fit includes dragged positions and label bounds. Returning from an empty result reattaches canvas pan/zoom and Fit.
network.labelBounds: 170px width; up to six 20px label lines plus 16px spacing and the type diameter; communities add 24px for status.
network.fit: Centered content with 48px margins; scale limited to 0.15 minimum and 0.85 maximum for communities or 1.1 maximum for individual nodes.
network.refinement: Hover/focus circles scale to 1.08 with a soft shadow; graph paper uses a 3% resolved-accent radial wash; ordinary edges have opacity 0.65/stroke 1.4px, affected edges opacity 0.85/stroke 1.6px.

overview.diff: Theme green/red ink and surface tokens mark actual added/removed JSON lines with plus/minus markers and endpoint selection status. Unchanged lines, including trailing-comma-only changes, remain neutral. Alignment is bounded to 400,000 cells, with unchanged prefix/suffix and coarser changed middle above that limit.

evidencePanels.testsAndRules: Distinct 0.8fr/1.2fr test-execution and compact rule areas, 32px gap and 230px minimum test column. Counts remain neutral recorded-entry badges. The inset CircleMinus state explicitly says repair tests have not run. Native disclosures retain attempt, duration, stdout/stderr and capped-output wording. A passed command requires zero exit code without timeout or cancellation; existing rule outcome semantics remain. Neutral/passed/failed rule badges reuse inset/green/red theme surfaces and inks; failure reasons use red ink.
evidencePanels.technical: Equal coverage/provenance columns with 36px gap. Amber notices retain actual limitation prose and source paths; an empty list never claims complete correctness. Raw API diff remains in a native disclosure. Alternating inset definition-list rows preserve full wrapping run ID, source commit and three input fingerprints, plus explicit missing-value wording and the existing JSON download action.
evidencePanels.responsive: At 1000px both grids stack with 24px gap and 160px provenance labels. At 600px headings reduce to 22px, provenance label/value rows stack with 5px gap and execution summaries wrap.

narrative.overview:
Warm white and black surfaces frame local repository work, with yellow selection and hover treatments. The persistent sidebar keeps repository context visible. DM Sans in Light and Plus Jakarta Sans in Dark supply interface hierarchy; Roboto Mono carries technical evidence. The user supplied the exact theme tokens; frontend/src/theme.css is their authoritative implementation, imported after page styles.

The workspace at `/` uses this approved replacement world. Shared theme primitives also reach the existing `/banking` demonstration; its account composition remains intact. Semantic community colors and green/red/amber evidence meanings retain their independent roles. Separately styled legacy demonstrations retain their own worlds. Surface composition belongs in `.impeccable/surfaces/workspace.md`.

The user approved a full home/dashboard revamp with sidebar repository selection, direct actions and a lighter warm-neutral/green character drawn loosely from supplied document-workspace images. `docs/home-redesign-direction.md` records seven considered directions and the reference-led selection; no exact pixel matching was requested for this home redesign. Previous Review Studio, circle-network, AI-provenance, readability and evidence-panel decisions remain product/history evidence where unaffected. Earlier 65% comp fidelity failure concerns an older build and remains historical; it does not measure this home redesign. Current documentation is source-grounded. `.impeccable/home-redesign-finish.md` retains recapture disposition because browser access was denied by security policy; fresh Light/Dark desktop/mobile review is pending.
keyCharacteristics: Black, warm white and yellow in user-supplied Light and Dark themes.
Persistent repository context and yellow current-page treatment.
Self-hosted DM Sans / Plus Jakarta Sans with Roboto Mono technical evidence.
One selected task panel and on-demand evidence details.
Community color independent of recorded impact, with explicit AI provenance.
Native controls, keyboard focus and reduced motion.

rules.name: The Paired Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow surfaces always carry their supplied dark foreground, including Dark theme selections and hover states.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Color supplements visible evidence labels. A completed comparison is not a tested repair, and a tested patch still needs review.

rules.name: The Community Fill Rule
rules.body: Community fill denotes membership; a red outline and affected label denote recorded impact independently. AI-inferred relationships never establish impact or repair acceptance.

rules.name: The Technical Text Rule
rules.body: Use the active supplied sans family for interface prose and Roboto Mono for code blocks; wrap meaningful evidence instead of clipping it.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and boundaries first; reserve soft shadows for actions, contextual emphasis and modal separation.

dos: Do use resolved workspace theme tokens for new controls.
Do pair evidence colors with visible status and provenance wording.
Do use labeled native controls, named icon actions and visible keyboard focus.
Do keep paths and endpoints readable in graph, list and detail views.
Do preserve reduced motion and a single selected task panel.
donts: Don't present linked tests as universal correctness or bounded static caller propagation as proven runtime failure or complete field-level analysis.
Don't initiate paid AI generation from ordinary appearance, graph exploration or interpretation-selection controls; Generate AI graph is the explicit paid action. GitHub publication remains separate.
Don't require authentication for the local workspace.
Don't spread this system into legacy routes without an explicit redesign.
Don't claim the latest source passed visual review or pixel fidelity while browser verification is pending.
